 </ol><p><span style="font-family:
     &quot;PT Sans&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">Insufficient
     information has been provided by the applicant with regard to
     extraction/plant machinery required on site to facilitate the
     proposed use.&nbsp; As such, the Local Planning Authority are unable to make a determination
     as to whether &nbsp;the proposal would
     result in unacceptable &nbsp;impacts on the
     residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers. The proposal is therefore
     contrary to Policies D3.D(7) and (9) and D14 of the London Plan (2021) and
     policies DM1 and DM37 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local
     Plan (2013).</span><o:p></o:p></p><ol start="1" type="1">
